title: Eclipse Relicario
description: Custom relic system mod created for special event gameplay. Adds a unique relic item with custom mechanics and event integration.
body:
elicario is a custom Fabric mod developed for structured multiplayer survival events.

This mod introduces a relic item that allows players to revive an eliminated teammate at a designated altar location.

What does this mod add?

A custom relic item

A revival mechanic tied to a specific altar

Controlled teammate resurrection system

Spectator-state integration for eliminated players

How it works

When a player is eliminated, they are placed in spectator mode.
Teammates can obtain the relic item and bring it to a special altar location to revive the eliminated player.

This creates strategic decision-making and high-risk gameplay moments during competitive survival events.

Purpose

The mod was designed specifically for organized event gameplay, where elimination and revival mechanics are part of the experience. It is not intended as a standard survival enhancement, but rather as a structured team-based event system.

Technical Information

Built for Minecraft 1.20.1

Requires Fabric Loader

Requires Fabric API
